name: POST /admin/meter/pricing-catalogs — api-gateway
description: Creates a new version of a pricing catalog, stamping created_by from operator_id, and returns 200 { success: true, data: <created version> }. QA edge cases: catalog_id, version and operator_id are all required and validated with a falsy check — which means version: 0 is rejected as missing even though it is a valid-looking integer, and empty strings are likewise rejected; version is not type-checked, so a string version is passed straight to the DB; re-creating an existing (catalog_id, version) pair violates the uniqueness constraint and surfaces as a 500 with the raw driver message rather than a 409 — there is no conflict branch in this handler; nothing verifies operator_id corresponds to a real operator, it is recorded as free text. NAMESPACE WARNING: the catalog_id this returns is a BILLING RATE CARD row in meter.pricing_catalog, and it is the only kind of catalog_id POST /api/billing/invoices/generate accepts. It is a different entity from the lakehouse catalog_id returned by POST /admin/federation/iceberg-catalogs (federation.iceberg_catalog), which shares the field name but is never valid for billing and yields 404 CatalogNotFound. Consume this one via the cache key meter-pricing-catalogs.create.response.data.catalog_id only. A catalog is created in `draft`; generation ignores draft catalogs, so PATCH .../status to active first, and PUT a rate for every sku that appears in the invoice usage[] or the line has no price to apply.

errorCases.when: requireAdmin() found no valid x-admin-ops-token header — missing, or matching neither env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN nor an active admin.ops_token hash (30s cache TTL applies to revocations)
catalog_id, version or operator_id is missing, null, an empty string, or (for version) the number 0 — the guard is a falsy check
createCatalogVersion() throws — most commonly a unique-constraint violation because that catalog_id/version already exists, or Postgres unavailable

testCases.name: Create a new draft pricing-catalog version
